criteria: Reviewed every LUX-204 acceptance criterion against the final source and isolated native Dockview evidence.
evidence: Independent source review confirmed the actions appear only when the current schema has groups; setAllGroups clears the query, clears openId to close an animation popover, and updates only disclosure state. It does not mutate controls or bindings. The final isolated run artifacts/inspector-density/run-1789631843186 used profile test-2a559a9b-6bf8-4f23-a69b-f3f7d427736e and real Collapse all / Expand all clicks. Its result records a 260px host, 245px Inspector with no horizontal overflow, and 17 controls. I visually reviewed collapsed and expanded screenshots: both actions fit beside Filter controls, accessible names and tooltip are present, collapsed group rows remain legible, and expansion restores all controls. The submission omitted its structured commit field; this decision records the exact reviewed commit while preserving that handoff omission.
